satellites.title: Aging and Death
satellites.evidence: Dependent-arising formulations include 老死. The treatment is doctrinal and should not be generalized into an empirical claim about reincarnation.

satellites.title: Death in the Twelve Links
satellites.evidence: In dependent-arising contexts, 死 occurs within 老死, linked to Sanskrit maraṇa. The technical use should be distinguished from broader imagery of death.
satellites.caveat: A proposed equivalence awaiting verification in an aligned Sanskrit–Chinese source; citation assignment is not verification.
gaps: Check the historical source translation as well as both dictionary senses.

satellites.title: Not Yet Knowing Life
satellites.evidence: Analects 11.12: asked about death, Confucius answers 未知生，焉知死 — “not yet knowing life, how could I know death?” In the same exchange: 未能事人，焉能事鬼, not yet able to serve people, how serve the dead?
